idea: Sort the edges from lightest to heaviest and take each one unless it would close a loop. A union-find structure answers 'are these two ends already connected?' very quickly. The edges taken form a minimum spanning tree.
useWhen: Connecting every node as cheaply as possible: cables, roads, pipes
avoidWhen: The graph is directed: spanning trees need undirected edges
The graph is very dense: Prim with a good queue may be better
